WITH table1 AS ( SELECT CONTRACT_ID FROM hxtypt.rpt_accmonth_firr_new GROUP BY contract_id HAVING TRUNC(max(PLAN_DATE)) >= TRUNC(TO_DATE('2023-01-01', 'YYYY-MM-DD')) ) SELECT 'TYPT' as systemCode, a.vc_hetbh AS contractCode, --合同编号 --> a.nu_jihqx AS periods, --计划期项 --> a.vc_wangybh AS ebankSerialNumber, --网银编号 --> a.dt_huilrq AS planDate, --回笼日期 --> -- a.dt_shurrq AS "dt_huijclr", --会计处理日 --> nvl(a.dec_huilzj,0) AS actualRepaymentRentAmount, --回笼租金 --> nvl(a.dec_huilbj,0) AS actualRepaymentPrincipalAmount, --回笼本金 --> -- nvl(a.dec_huillxfx,0) AS "dec_huillxfx", --06/30回笼本金罚息 --> -- nvl(a.dec_huilbjfx,0) AS "dec_huilbjfx", --06/30回笼本金罚息 --> nvl(a.dec_huilzx,0) AS actualRepaymentInteresAmount --回笼租息 --> -- nvl(a.dec_huilfx,0) AS "dec_huilfx", --回笼罚息 --> -- nvl(a.dec_faxtz,0) AS "dec_faxtz", --罚息调整 --> -- a.vc_fukr AS "vc_fukr", --付款人 --> -- a.vc_shifdf AS "vc_shifdf", --是否代付 --> -- vc_jiesfs AS "vc_jiesfs" FROM hxtypt.FM_ZuJHL a --租金回笼表 --> INNER JOIN table1 d ON a.vc_hetbh = d.CONTRACT_ID
and a.vc_hetbh = #{params.contractCode}

SELECT bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh AS contractCode, inter_orgcode.org_name AS orgId, ba_hetztzd.vc_zhuangtmc AS 合同状态, CASE WHEN dt_shijqzr >= to_date('2009-04-01', 'yyyy/mm/dd') OR vc_zhuangtmc = '合同签约' THEN 'New' ELSE 'Legacy' END "New/Legacy Portfolio", shifyzx.vc_mingc AS 是否注销, inter_custid_join.cust_id_f AS 财务客户号, cm_jigkh.vc_kehmc AS 承租人, ta_bal.vc_wangybh AS 网银编号, fm_wangysj.dt_daozsj AS 网银到账日期, fm_wangysj.vc_fukkh AS 网银付款人名称, zulxgbz.vc_mingc AS 网银是否与业务相关, ta_memo.vc_beiz AS 备注, nvl(ta_bal.ta_bal, 0) AS taAmount, ta_bal.ta_caozrq AS 操作日期, fm_wangysj.vc_suosgs AS 到账账号所属公司 FROM ( SELECT vc_hetbh, vc_wangybh, SUM(dec_shouzje) ta_bal, MIN(dt_chuangjsj) ta_caozrq FROM hxtypt.fm_shissf WHERE vc_feiylx = '206' AND dt_huijclr < to_date('2024-07-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd') + 1 --入参 查询截至日期 --查询截止日期入参 GROUP BY vc_hetbh, vc_wangybh ) ta_bal LEFT JOIN ( SELECT fm_shissf.vc_hetbh, fm_shissf.vc_wangybh, fm_shissf.vc_beiz FROM hxtypt.fm_shissf INNER JOIN ( SELECT vc_hetbh, vc_wangybh, MAX(nu_id) id FROM hxtypt.fm_shissf WHERE vc_feiylx = '206' AND dt_huijclr < to_date('2024-07-01', 'yyyy-mm-dd') + 1 --入参 查询截至日期 --查询截止日期入参 GROUP BY vc_hetbh, vc_wangybh ) a ON a.vc_hetbh = fm_shissf.vc_hetbh AND a.vc_wangybh = fm_shissf.vc_wangybh AND a.id = fm_shissf.nu_id ) ta_memo ON ta_memo.vc_hetbh = ta_bal.vc_hetbh AND ta_memo.vc_wangybh = ta_bal.vc_wangybh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.bz_hetjbxx ON bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh = ta_bal.vc_hetbh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.bz_hetgf ON bz_hetgf.vc_hetbh = bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.inter_orgcode ON inter_orgcode.cust_id = bz_hetgf.vc_chuzr LEFT JOIN hxtypt.cm_jigkh ON cm_jigkh.vc_kehbh = bz_hetjbxx.vc_kehbh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.inter_custid_join ON inter_custid_join.cust_id_b = bz_hetjbxx.vc_kehbh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.fm_wangysj ON fm_wangysj.vc_wangybh = ta_bal.vc_wangybh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.ba_hetztzd ON ba_hetztzd.vc_zhuangtbh = bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetzt LEFT JOIN hxtypt.ba_shujzd shifyzx ON bz_hetjbxx.vc_shifyzx = shifyzx.vc_zhi AND shifyzx.vc_fujdid = 'flag' LEFT JOIN hxtypt.ba_shujzd zulxgbz ON fm_wangysj.ch_zulxgbz = zulxgbz.vc_zhi AND zulxgbz.vc_fujdid = 'flag' WHERE nvl(ta_bal.ta_bal, 0) > 0

SELECT DISTINCT bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh contract_code,--合同编号
inter_orgcode.org_code AS org_id, --签约主体 inter_orgcode.org_name AS org_name, --签约主体名称
--bz_hetjbxx.dt_shijqzr, --shifyzx.vc_mingc AS vc_shifyzx, --inter_custid_join.cust_id_f, ba_hetztzd.vc_zhuangtmc contract_status,--合同状态 bz_hetjbxx.vc_kehbh client_code,--客户编号 vi_cust_all_info.kehmc as client_name,--客户名称 --bb_getBadDays('1900-01-01', to_char(SYSDATE, 'yyyy-mm-dd'), --bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh) AS badDays, ta_bal.vc_wangybh ebank_serial_number,--业务系统网银编号/批次号 ta_memo.vc_beiz operation_remark,--运营部备注 --fm_wangysj.dt_daozsj, fm_wangysj.vc_fukkh ebank_client_name,--网银付款人名称 --zulxgbz.vc_mingc AS ch_zulxgbz, --CASE --WHEN dt_shijqzr >= to_date('2009-04-01', 'yyyy/mm/dd') OR -- vc_zhuangtmc = '合同签约' THEN -- 'New' -- ELSE --'Legacy' -- END Portfolio, nvl(ta_bal.ta_bal, 0) ta_excess_balance--TA/溢存款余额 --t2.rent - nvl(t3.rent, 0) as 租金余额--应收租金余额 --ta_bal.ta_caozrq FROM (SELECT vc_hetbh, vc_wangybh, SUM(dec_shouzje) ta_bal, MIN(dt_chuangjsj) ta_caozrq FROM hxtypt.fm_shissf fm_shissf WHERE vc_feiylx = '206' AND dt_huijclr < to_date(#{queryDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') + 1 GROUP BY vc_hetbh, vc_wangybh) ta_bal LEFT JOIN (SELECT fm_shissf.vc_hetbh, fm_shissf.vc_wangybh, fm_shissf.vc_beiz FROM hxtypt.fm_shissf fm_shissf INNER JOIN (SELECT vc_hetbh, vc_wangybh, MAX(nu_id) id FROM hxtypt.fm_shissf fm_shissf WHERE vc_feiylx = '206' AND dt_huijclr < to_date(#{queryDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') + 1 GROUP BY vc_hetbh, vc_wangybh) a ON a.vc_hetbh = fm_shissf.vc_hetbh AND a.vc_wangybh = fm_shissf.vc_wangybh AND a.id = fm_shissf.nu_id) ta_memo ON ta_memo.vc_hetbh = ta_bal.vc_hetbh AND ta_memo.vc_wangybh = ta_bal.vc_wangybh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.bz_hetjbxx bz_hetjbxx ON bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh = ta_bal.vc_hetbh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.vi_cust_all_info vi_cust_all_info ON vi_cust_all_info.kehbh = bz_hetjbxx.vc_kehbh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.inter_custid_join inter_custid_join ON inter_custid_join.cust_id_b = bz_hetjbxx.vc_kehbh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.fm_wangysj fm_wangysj ON fm_wangysj.vc_wangybh = ta_bal.vc_wangybh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.ba_hetztzd ba_hetztzd ON ba_hetztzd.vc_zhuangtbh = bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetzt LEFT JOIN hxtypt.ba_shujzd shifyzx ON bz_hetjbxx.vc_shifyzx = shifyzx.vc_zhi AND shifyzx.vc_fujdid = 'flag' LEFT JOIN hxtypt.ba_shujzd zulxgbz ON fm_wangysj.ch_zulxgbz = zulxgbz.vc_zhi AND zulxgbz.vc_fujdid = 'flag' LEFT JOIN hxtypt.bz_hetgf bz_hetgf ON bz_hetgf.vc_hetbh = bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh LEFT JOIN hxtypt.inter_orgcode inter_orgcode ON inter_orgcode.cust_id = bz_hetgf.vc_chuzr --LEFT JOIN (SELECT vc_cesztbh, SUM(dec_zuj) rent, SUM(dec_zux) interest --FROM fm_jiaoyjgzjjh --GROUP BY vc_cesztbh) t2 --ON bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh = t2.vc_cesztbh --LEFT JOIN (SELECT vc_hetbh, SUM(dec_huilzj) rent, SUM(dec_huilzx) interest --FROM fm_zujhl --WHERE nvl(dt_huijclr, dt_huilrq) < to_date('会计回笼截止日期入参','yyyy/mm/dd') + 1 --会计回笼截止日期入参 --GROUP BY vc_hetbh) t3 --ON bz_hetjbxx.vc_hetbh = t3.vc_hetbh WHERE nvl(ta_bal.ta_bal, 0) > 0

SELECT b.vc_mingc as isTransferTemporaryCredit, --是否转为暂收款 a.vc_wangybh as ebankSerialNumber, --网银编号 a.vc_daozyh as collectionAccountsBankName, --到账银行 a.vc_fukkh as paymentClientName, --付款客户 a.dt_daozsj as businessDate, --网银到账日期 nvl(a.dec_daozje, 0) as ebankAmount, --网银金额 (nvl(c.t1, 0) + nvl(d.t2, 0)) as confirmedAmount, --已确认金额 (nvl(a.dec_daozje, 0) - (nvl(c.t1, 0) + nvl(d.t2, 0) + nvl(z.t3,0))) as nonConfirmedAmount, --未确认金额 a.vc_zhaiy as remark, --摘要 CASE WHEN (nvl(a.dec_daozje, 0) - (nvl(c.t1, 0) + nvl(d.t2, 0) + nvl(z.t3,0))) = 0 THEN '零' ELSE '非零' END type FROM hxtypt.fm_wangysj a LEFT JOIN hxtypt.ba_shujzd b ON b.vc_zhi = a.ch_shifyzwzsk AND b.vc_fujdid = 'flag' LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vc_wangybh, SUM(nvl(dec_huilzj, 0) + nvl(dec_huilfx, 0) + nvl(dec_huandje, 0)) AS t1 FROM hxtypt.fm_zujhl WHERE 1=1 and trunc(nvl(dt_huijclr, dt_huilrq)) <= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') GROUP BY vc_wangybh ) c ON c.vc_wangybh = a.vc_wangybh LEFT JOIN ( SELECT vc_wangybh, SUM(nvl(dec_shouzje, 0)) AS t2 FROM hxtypt.fm_shissf WHERE 1=1 and vc_shouffx='收款' and trunc(nvl(dt_huijclr, dt_shouzrq)) <= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') GROUP BY vc_wangybh ) d ON d.vc_wangybh = a.vc_wangybh left join ( select ebank_number,sum(nvl(fact_money,0)) t3 from hxtypt.mfund_fund_charge where 1=1 and trunc(nvl(accounting_date,fact_date)) <= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') group by ebank_number )z on a.vc_wangybh = z.ebank_number WHERE a.ch_youxbs = '0' AND a.ch_zulxgbz = '0' and (nvl(a.dec_daozje, 0) - (nvl(c.t1, 0) + nvl(d.t2, 0) + nvl(z.t3,0))) <> 0 and trunc(dt_shangcrq) <= to_date(#{params.queryDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd')
